(nga )༄༅/ /gser chos mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi tshogs 'khor bya tshul bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba zhugs so/ /rab 'byams zhing gi rgya

tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// gser chos mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi tshogs 'khor bya tshul bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba zhugs so// rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal ba yi// gsang gsum yon tan mi zad mdzod// tshul khrims dag pa'i rnam rol gyis// don gnyis lhun gyis grub la 'dud// 'dod pa'i dngos grub dgug pa dang*// dam tshig nyams pa gso ba'i phyir// tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya tshul gyi// cho ga bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho bri// 'dir rnal 'byor pa gang zhig mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi sgrub mchod la sogs pa'i skabs su tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdor bsdus tsam ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ phal cher sgrub mchod kyi skabs bzhin las khyad par maṇḍal gyi mdun la sogs par tshogs 'khor gyi rdzas sha chang dang zan la sogs pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba tshogs bzhag go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la tshim pa drug las/ 'byung po'i tshogs gtor mas tshim pa'i bar mdun bskyed dang 'brel bas logs su mi dgos shing*/ bzhi pa dam tshig dang ldan pa'i gang zag nang gi sbyin sreg gis tshim pa ni/ dpon slob rnams rang rang gi gnas gsum du rdo rje dang bcas pa'i bsang chus de dag la 'bru gsum brjod pas sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du byin gyis brlabs la/ las kyi rdo rjes nyer spyod lnga bsham/ phyag 'tshal sngon du 'gro bas thams cad rje btsun mar gsal ba la thun mong du/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ḍā ki ni singha mu kha sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra puṣpe nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod nas tshogs 'khor gyi yo byad rnams mdun du 'dus byas pa la nang mchod kyis bran la/ las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum byas la/ 'greng ste thal mo sbyar nas/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams byin brlab mdzad pa zhu zhes gsol ba gdab/ dpon slob thams cad kyis tshogs rdzas nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥmang du brjod cing dmigs pa gsal bas zag med kyi bdud rtsir yang yang bsam mo// de nas ma da na la sogs pa'i btung ba dang ba la la sogs pa'i bza' ba thams cad bsdus la 'jig rten las 'das pa dang ma 'das pa'i gtor ma cha gnyis su byas pa'i cha gcig maṇḍal gyi mdun du bzhag cha gcig yi dam chos skyong gi gtor ma la bzhag cing chang gis bran/ phyag gsum byas la/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la tshogs phud 'bul ba zhu zhes brjod pa dang*/ thams cad kyi/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇī ka ha badzra sa pa ri wā ra oṃ inda sogs kyis kye rdor dang*/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥsogs kyis mthar a kā ro btags pas bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i rje btsun ma dang*/ gzhan yang chos skyong gang yin pa la yang rang rang gi sngags lan gsum gsum dang oṃ kha kha khā hi sogs gsum gyis mkha' 'gro spyi gtor rnams phul/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar dang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'thor zhing*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol zhes brjod/ de nas rang lhar gsal ba'i kha hom khung dang lag pa gnyis hūm̐ las rdo rje'i gzar bu gnyis dang*/ lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba'i me lce'i khrod na 'jig rten pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang*/ snying gar pad nyi'i steng du yi dam gyi lha tshogs gsal ba bsgoms la/ shes shing nus na rdo rje'i bzlas pa cung zad bya zhing*/ sgo gsum tha mal gyi rnam rtog 'gyur nges su bsgom mo// de nas las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum byas la me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar la/

rdo rje 'dzin sogs dgongs su gsol// bdag gis tshogs kyi khyad par 'di// dwang ba'i sems kyis 'bul lags na// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab cing me tog gtor// slob dpon gyis/ e ma ho ye shes chen po rnams// tshogs chen 'bar bas nyon mongs bsregs// 'di 'dra'i bde ba thob nas ni// kun gyis a ho su kha brjod// ces brjod pa'i rjes su/ thams cad kyis a ho su kha bha kṣa ṇa/ a ho su kha pra ye na/ ma hā mu dra siddha naṃ/ pra wardha na nṛ tya naṃ// hūm̐ ha ha ho hoḥzhes pa'am/ de bod skad du brjod na/ e ma bde ba'i longs spyod 'di// e ma bde ba rab gsal nyid// phyag rgya chen po grub pa 'di// rab tu 'phel ba'i rol gar 'di// hūm̐ ha ha ho hoḥzhes brjod/ de nas las kyi rdo rje thams cad kyi mdun du thod pa'am/ ma 'byor na thod par bsams pa'i snod ma da nas bkang ba bzhag la/ slob dpon la phyag dang pad skor dang gzhan rnams la pad skor sngon du 'gro bas/ thod pa lag pa g.yas pas bzung*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis ba la cung zad bzung ste/ thod pa'i steng nas bkab ste/ 'di ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'dus pa la ni the tshom med// bram ze gdol pa khyi dang phag /rang bzhin gcig tu rol te gsol// zhes brjod/ len pa pos kyang*/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma spongs// gzung dang 'dzin pa kun bral ba// de bzhin nyid la gus phyag 'tshal// zhes brjod cing gnyis kas a ho su kha zhes brjod la las kyi rdo rjes dam tshig ma thob kyi bar du lag tu bzung*/ dam tshig thob pa dang stegs kyi steng du bzhag de nas ba la la sogs pa'i bza' ba rnams slob dpon la nyis 'gyur dang*/ gzhan rnams la che chung med par rim gyis drangs/ stob pa pos kyang a ho su kha zhes brjod cing lag pa gnyis kas bstab/ len pa pos kyang a ho su kha zhes brjod cing blangs la/

bza' btung stegs med par sa la mi 'jog de ltar yo byad thams cad bstabs tshar ba dang*/ kha zas kyi phud kyis dkon mchog dang yi dam la mchod pa dang*/ 'phrog ma la chang bu sbyin pa sogs spyi ltar byas la/ rang lha'i 'du shes dang rnam pa mi 'khrul ba'i ngang nas nang gi sbyin sreg gsal btab nas tshim par bza'o// 'dir rab tu byung ba sdom ldan rnams kyis kyang sdom pa 'og ma'i bcas pa dang 'gal gyis dogs pas ma da na dang phyi dro'i kha zas spong sems kyis tshogs rdzas la smad na rtsa ltung du 'gyur bas/ dam tshig blangs te ljags la reg pa tsam bya ba dang*/ bu ram sbrang rtsi zhun mar rnams sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bsams pas nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul gyis bza'o// rnal 'byor pa gzhan rnams kyis kyang dam tshig gi rdzas la bag med du mi spyod par ran par bya ba dang*/ tshogs kyi skabs su rtsod pa dang kha shag 'gyed pa sogs mi bya bar chos kyi gtam dang rdo rje'i glu gar la sogs pas dus 'da' ba bya zhing*/ gzhan yang sha la ba la dang chang la ma da na la sogs pa'i brda'i skad kyis smra dgos te/ kye rdo rje las/ gal te sangs rgyas gsang ba'i skad// mi gsungs na ni 'grongs par 'gyur// zhes sogs mang du gsungs te/ mdor na tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bslab bya rgyas pa gzhan du shes par bya'i 'dir yi ge mangs kyis dogs pas ma bris so// de nas slob dpon gyis de kho na nyid la cung zad mnyam par bzhag nas skabs 'dir yon bdag tshogs bsags pa'i phyir don thabs dang shes rab ldan pa'i chos bshad par gsungs kyang yon bdag dam tshig la sogs pa dang tshul bzhin ldan pa dka' bas de'i tshab tu sngags kha yar zhig bzlas na des chog par sems so// lnga pa phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro ma rnams glu gar gyis tshim par bya ba ni/ glu gar bya ba 'os pa la slob dpon gyis bka' stsal zhing*/ de dag gis kyang lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos/

kollaḥ.i reṭa sogs rdo rje'i gar rgyas par bya ba'am de ma grub na sngar gyi/ a ho su kha sogs rkang pa bzhi la glu gar bya zhing*/ ma shes na ma byas kyang chog ces kun bzang rnam rol du bshad do// drug pa lus kyi dkyil 'khor lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyis tshim pa ni/ rab tu byung ba rnams kyis snying gar mar gyi nying gu'am ma da na byugs la cung zad mnye zhing*/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo rje btsun ma rang snang gi yab dang bcas pa bsgoms la snyoms par zhugs pas/ bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin rgyud las skyes par bsam pa ste dngos gzhi tshim pa drug go /gsum pa rjes la drug gi dang po lhag ma'i gtor ma btang ba ni/ bza' btung gi lhag ma rnams shing gzhong la sogs pa'i snod du mas rim gyis bsdus la/ mtshan mo yin na grib gnon gyi gdon bsrung ba'i phyir dpal 'bar dang bcas te slob dpon gyi mdun du bzhag la/ phyag gsum byas te/ lhag ma'i gtor ma byin rlabs mdzad pa zhu zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyis ma da na cung zad 'thungs nas lag pa 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i nang nas/ ngag tu phaiṃ zhes brjod pa dang bstun la gtor ma la kha phrus btab/ de nas phud dam chu gtsang cung zad kyang bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ utstshiṣṭa ba linta bhakṣa si swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum brjod pas bsngos la se gol gtogs/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po thams cad tshim par gyur cig ces brjod la lam gyi bzhi mdor dor ro// gnyis pa bkra shis brjod pa ni/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ kollaḥ.i reṭaṭhi sogs dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs nas bkra shis gsum pa'o// zhes pa'i rjes su/ rgyal ba sras bcas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kun gyis legs par bsam pa dang*// gsang sngags rig sngags rnams kyi mthu stobs dang*// bden par smra ba rnams kyi bden tshig gis// bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang*// rgyud ni nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba dang*// snyan pa nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa ste// gsum po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog

/bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*// mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang*// 'dod pa grub cing phun sum tshogs pa ste// bzhi po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang*// tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs pa dang*// theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung ba yi// lnga po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims bsrung ba dang*// bzod pa bsgom zhing brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*// mnyam par 'jog cing shes rab bskyed pa ste// drug po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /nyin mor bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa// dkon mchog gsum gyis deng 'dir stsol// zhes brjod do// gsum pa lhag chad kha bskang ba'i phyir he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs bzod par mdzod kyi bar brjod/ bzhi pa smon lam gdab pa ni sbyin bdag gis gser la sogs pa'i yon dang bcas te gsol ba btab ngor 'di skad du/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad bdag cag rnams la dgongs su gsol/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i zhes sogs nas/ de yis sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /ces dang*/ bla med bla ma'i thugs rje zhes sogs nas/ smon lam 'grub par shog ces pa'i bar gyi bsngo ba smon lam bya'o// lnga pa mgron gshegs su gsol ba man chad ni mdun bskyed kyi rjes chog la sogs pa byas pas 'thus so// smras pa/ de ltar rjod par byed pa'i tshig /mang po min pas brjod bya nyid// rdzogs par ston pa tshim drug gi /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga 'di// rgyal ba dges pa'i blo gros can// mang pos legs par gdams pa'i srol// gces par bzung nas khyad par chos// 'byed 'dir 'gal ba med par sems// bsod nams tshogs kyi rgya mtsho ste// mkha' 'gro ngang pa'i tshogs kun sdud// dngos grub 'dab brgya 'byung ba'i phyir// 'di ni bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho yin// dge ba de yis skye bo kun// gsang chen chos kyi mdzod bzung nas// zab mo'i snod gyur sems can rnams// smin cing grol bar byed par shog

/ces rje btsun sa skya pa'i gser chos mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi tshogs 'khor bya tshul cho ga bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni dpal sa skya pa yab sras dang*/ rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po la sogs pa'i gsung rab rnams kyi don dang mi 'gal bar ngag 'don gyi tshul bde bar bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa dge tshogs rnam par 'phel bar gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
